jobs.prompt: IDENTITY: the two reference photographs show ONE woman, the HNK model — keep her EXACT face in every detail: a slim oval face that narrows to a small, softly pointed chin; large, round-leaning almond eyes set a touch wide, with a deep double eyelid crease, a light warm-brown iris and long heavy lashes under a soft winged liner; straight brows with a low gentle arch, darker and fuller than average; a small nose, narrow at the bridge, neat and rounded at the tip; FULL lips with a distinctly fuller lower lip, a sharply drawn cupid's bow and a deep rose-red lip colour; high rounded cheekbones with a warm pink blush; fair porcelain skin, early twenties. Same person, same face shape, same eyes, nose, lips and jawline as the references — do not redesign, slim, age, harden or replace her. IGNORE in the references and copy NONE of it: the silver headdress, the silver earrings, the embroidered collar, her clothing and the sky behind her — only the face. Create a photograph of the HNK model from the references (the same face, fair luminous porcelain skin, long dark hair worn loose over one shoulder, soft natural glam, early twenties, slim, elegant), standing outdoors on a dry grass field at the edge of a countryside paddock in warm late-afternoon sun, wearing a cream knitted long-sleeve top and high-waisted camel-brown wide-leg trousers with flat brown boots, her body turned slightly to her left, both hands relaxed at her sides, looking at the camera with a calm soft smile; a plain low wooden fence and soft out-of-focus green hills far behind her, warm low side light from the front-right, a soft natural shadow on the grass, 50mm lens at chest height, HORIZONTAL 3:2 framing, the woman standing in the LEFT third of the frame from mid-thigh up, with clear open field to her right; a real photograph, natural skin texture with visible pores, sharp focus on the eyes, no studio gear, no props, no animals, no straw, no other person, no text, no logo, no watermark.
